rules.raisingPolicy: If weights need to be raised at final acceptances, Caulfield and Melbourne Cup weights are raised uniformly.

methodologyNotes: The topweight anchor is mandatory: at least one horse must be allotted 59kg when Cup handicaps are declared.
A normal ratings-to-weight conversion alone is therefore insufficient; the field must be scaled around the handicapper's selected anchor horse.
International ratings, Australian ratings, age/sex, proven Group form, staying performances and the horse's position relative to the topweight all require review.
Northern Hemisphere three-year-olds must be treated on the applicable three-year-old scale rather than as fully mature older horses.
Our pre-release estimates will be frozen before 17 September and retained after the official weights are published so prediction error can be audited.
source: Racing Victoria Handicapping Principles and 2025-26 handicap-condition changes
